intro.title: A CRM That Fits Your Business, Not the Other Way Round
paragraphs: A CRM (Customer Relationship Management) system helps your business capture every enquiry, follow up on time, close more deals and resolve customer issues before they become complaints. When it works, everyone from sales to support sees the same customer story. When it does not fit, teams fall back to spreadsheets and WhatsApp, and leads slip through the cracks.

That is why many businesses choose custom CRM development. Instead of paying per user for features you never use, you get a CRM system built around your own sales stages, approval rules, products and reports. We design and develop CRMs for sales teams, service centres, real estate developers, pharma companies, agencies and growing businesses of every kind.

Our CRM software development services cover consulting, CRM software design, web and mobile development, data migration, integrations and long-term support. Your CRM can run on your own servers or as a cloud SaaS option, and you own the code. Explore our <csd>custom software development</csd> or <contact>tell us how your team sells today</contact>.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about CRM software development.

items.a: CRM software development is designing and building a Customer Relationship Management system that helps a business capture leads, manage sales, communicate with customers and resolve service requests. A custom CRM is built around your own process instead of a generic template.

items.q: Is a custom CRM better than a ready-made CRM?
items.a: A ready-made CRM is fine for small teams with a simple sales process. A custom CRM is better when your process is unique, you need industry features or deep integrations, or per-user fees are getting expensive as your team grows.

items.q: How much does custom CRM development cost?
items.a: A starter CRM typically costs $5,000 to $15,000, a business CRM with mobile app and integrations $15,000 to $40,000, and an enterprise CRM with ERP integration $40,000 or more. We give a fixed, itemised quote after a free consultation.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a CRM?
items.a: A starter CRM usually goes live in 4 to 8 weeks. Business CRMs take 2 to 4 months and enterprise CRMs 4 months or more. Core modules are released early so your team can start using them sooner.

items.q: Do you build CRM software for real estate developers?
items.a: Yes. Our real estate CRM handles enquiries from property portals and ads, site visits, unit availability, bookings, payment schedules, channel partners and post-sales service in one system.

items.q: Can you integrate the CRM with WhatsApp, telephony and ERP, or migrate my existing CRM?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with WhatsApp, IVR and telephony, email, website forms, ERP and accounting software, and we migrate contacts, deals and history from your current CRM or spreadsheets without data loss.
